audit_preparation_failures: First audit compared whole Memory objects with generated creation timestamps. Original script and failure note retained; corrected audit compares actual model-visible rendering and stable evidence fields.
Second audit used nonexistent metadata field instead of structured_content; script and failure note retained. Product and fixtures were not changed by reviewer.
Third audit matched bare number 18 in date metadata rather than passage content; retained failed script, then narrowed the assertion to the initial passage.
limitations: Seven ANSWER cases need tool evidence to justify the expected fact. The ABSTAIN case could reasonably refuse with initial evidence alone; its separate tool contract requires checking the reply before concluding the premise is unavailable.

Each fixture has at most three sources and search returns up to eight. This evaluates invoking tools and using returned evidence, not query quality, retrieval ranking or a large distractor collection.
The two appendix fixtures permit either search or read. They do not prove that the model selected the explicit read operation.
Forbidden facts are semantic assertions, not banned substrings. Mentioning old draft 11 while clearly stating current final 8 is not an error.

The identity question presupposes the named project assignment. Prior overly strict required assignment citation was clarified before any paid evaluation; final fixture requires approval evidence. The unseen approval amount is the necessary tool evidence.
These are synthetic development fixtures, not an independent holdout or benchmark accuracy result.
